insight: Ships guMCP, its own open-source MCP server suite, so flows call tools through a standard protocol instead of bespoke per-app connectors.
name: Gumloop
tagline: No-code AI workflow automation on a visual node canvas.
description: A drag-and-drop platform for building AI-powered automations as node graphs — web scraping, document parsing, image analysis, and multi-model chaining without code. Connects apps, data, and LLMs into triggered or scheduled flows. Backed by Y Combinator and a Benchmark-led Series B.

modelSupport.notes: Chains multiple LLMs across nodes; model selectable per AI step.

edge: AI-native canvas where agents and workflows call each other, plus MCP integrations built from a prompt.
pros: Agents can call workflows and self-correct
Build MCP integrations via natural language
cons: Less mature error handling than Make
